headline: Personality Hub, from entry to detail
overview: The Personality Hub is your central dashboard for all personality assessments on Inner Quest. From one place, you can see which assessments you've completed, jump into ones you haven't, and get a synthesized overview of how your personality profiles across MBTI, Big Five, DISC, Enneagram, and other frameworks fit together. It's the starting point for deep self-knowledge about who you are and how you operate.
targetAudience: Users interested in personality tools for personal growth and self-discovery.

keyFeatures: Central dashboard showing all available personality assessments and completion status
Quick access to MBTI, Big Five, DISC, Enneagram, and other frameworks
Cross-framework synthesis showing how your results fit together
Shareable personality profile linking your completed assessments
tips: Start with Big Five for the most scientifically validated personality profile
Complete multiple assessments over time — each framework reveals a different facet of your personality
